seo.title: Bright Consortium Ltd. | Railway LED, Billboards & Train Branding in Bangladesh
seo.description: Train-schedule LED screens at 10 Bangladesh Railway stations, outdoor LED screens and illuminated billboards in Dhaka and Chattogram, highway billboards, and train body and seat-cover branding.
seo.keywords: LED advertising Bangladesh, railway station LED, billboard Dhaka, billboard Chattogram, train branding, train wrap, seat cover branding, outdoor advertising Bangladesh

hero.text: Train-schedule LED screens at 10 major railway stations, LED screens and illuminated billboards across Dhaka and Chattogram, highway billboards and full train branding: one partner, lit 24/7.

about.statement: Bright Consortium connects brands with *millions of people every day*: on railway platforms, inside and outside trains, and along the busiest roads of Dhaka, Chattogram and the national highways.
about.text: Bangladesh Railway is one of the country's largest transport networks, linking key commercial and economic corridors. We place premium illuminated advertising where those journeys happen, so your brand earns strong recall and long-term impact.

points.title: Lit 24/7
points.text: Premium illuminated formats that stay visible day and night.

points.text: Entrances, platforms, ticket counters, parking areas and terminal zones.

services.title: Five ways to be *seen.*
services.text: Pick one format or combine them into a nationwide campaign. Every option is offered on a one-year rental basis.

items.title: Train schedule + advertising LED
items.text: LED screens that show the live train timetable alongside your ads, so passengers keep looking. Placed at entrances, concourses, ticket counters and platforms.
features: About 8 large and 42 small LED screens
10 major stations including Kamalapur, Airport, Chattogram and Cox's Bazar
Peak (12 hours) and off-peak (4 hours) slots

items.title: Outdoor LED screens
items.text: Large LED screens at high-traffic junctions: Airport Road, Khilkhet, Banani, Kamalapur, and Chattogram's New Market, Tiger Pass and Lalkhan Bazar.

items.title: Illuminated billboards
items.text: Landmark billboards along Airport Road, Kuril, Banani and Chattogram, plus highway sites on the Dhaka–Sirajganj, Dhaka–Natore and Dhaka–Rangpur routes.
features: Sizes from 6 × 8 ft light boxes to 50 × 10 ft boards
16 light boxes from Tiger Pass to Lalkhan Bazar

items.title: Train body branding
items.text: Turn whole trains into moving billboards. Selected for high passenger volume, maximum station coverage, daily operation and wide geographic reach.

items.title: Seat cover & seat-back branding
items.text: Your brand in front of every seated passenger for the whole journey. We clean, maintain and replace the branded covers and stickers throughout the contract.
features: Covers washed and refitted four times a month
Damaged stickers replaced at no extra charge

terms.title: Clear terms. *No surprises.*
terms.text: The essentials of how we work. The full terms are set out in your agreement.

items.a: All media is offered on a one (01) year rental basis. Renewal for the next year is confirmed before the first-year display period ends (for train branding, at least three months before expiry).
Peak hours run 7am–1pm and 5pm–11pm (12 hours). Off-peak runs 1pm–5pm (4 hours). The video loop is planned together with you.
An advance is paid on confirmation: 40% for LED screens, 60% for train body branding (the balance in two equal instalments) and 50% for seat cover branding. The balance follows the agreed schedule.
Yes. Quoted rates include 15% VAT and 4% AIT as applicable under the laws of Bangladesh.

LED screens are ready to display and maintenance materials are provided by us. For train branding, artwork adaptation, printing, transport and the first installation are included, with a six-month warranty on stickers. Seat covers are washed and refitted four times a month.
All media follows the rules and directives of Bangladesh Railway, the Ministry of Railways and the Government of Bangladesh. Any directive from the authorities is implemented accordingly.
